summary:
## 1. Customer Profile
The customer, Susan, is a female from England who has been living in Finland for four months. She is a single parent with a three-year-old daughter named Vivian, who speaks English at home. Susan has a full-time job and is looking for daycare options for her daughter.

## 2. Reason for Visit
Susan came to the service today to inquire about daycare options for her daughter, as she is finding it difficult to balance her full-time job and caring for Vivian. She is not familiar with the daycare system in Finland and is seeking guidance and information to help her make an informed decision.

## 3. Topics Discussed
The conversation covered various topics related to daycare options in Espoo, including the different types of care available (municipal, private, family daycare, and open playground playgroups), the costs associated with each option, and the application process. The customer also asked about the age group system in Finnish daycare and how children are grouped together.

## 4. Guidance and Information Provided
The customer was provided with information about the different types of daycare options available in Espoo, including the English-speaking private daycare, Bilge Pajverkodit, which offers bilingual or language-enriched early childhood education. The customer was also informed about the application process, which involves applying online through the BilgePajverkodit website, and the fees associated with each option. The customer was also told about the municipal daycare system, which offers early childhood education and has fees ranging from 0 to 300 euros per month, depending on family income. The customer was also introduced to the e-services online platform, Ivaka, which can be used to communicate with daycare centers and book attendance times.

## 5. Referrals and Next Steps
The customer was referred to the BilgePajverkodit website to apply for the English-speaking private daycare and to the Espoo City website for information on municipal daycare options. The customer was advised to apply online and to come back to the service if she needs further assistance. The customer was also told that she can email the service to set up a follow-up appointment to work on the applications together.

## 6. Additional Observations
The customer seemed to be in a state of uncertainty and was seeking guidance and reassurance about the daycare options available in Espoo. The conversation was conducted in a friendly and helpful manner, with the customer being provided with clear and concise information about the different options available. The customer was also encouraged to take the initiative to apply online and to seek further assistance if needed.

extraction.Referrals_Made: Bilge Pajverkodit (English-speaking daycare in Espoo), Espoo.fi (city of Espoo's website for early childhood education and daycare)
extraction.Confidence_Notes: All fields extracted with reasonable confidence
